specific_competences.main_competence: . Demonstrate mastery of the principles of Book-keeping
specific_competences.specific_competence: . Demonstrate an understanding of the basic principles and theories of Book-keeping
learning_activities: (a) Explain the concept of Book Keeping (origin, meaning, purpose, relationship with other disciplines and basic terms)
(b) Explain the basis for recording business transactions (accounting assumptions and principles)
(c) Describe the theory of the double-entry system of Book- keeping(the accounting equation)
(d) Describe various types of accounts (assets, liabilities, capital, revenue and expenses)
teaching_methods: Brainstorming: why and where business owners keep their financial records in community Presentation: discuss and summarize by connecting their views to the books of original entry; meaning and purpose of Book-keeping case study: to lead students to discuss the relationship of Book-keeping and other subjects then conclude the discussion

Group discussion Provide documents of accounting assumptions and principles for students to discuss aspects that guide the recording of business transactions Presentation: Randomly select students from the groups to present their views in plenary and conclude

Skills lab: Group Discussion: Organize students to discuss the theory of double-entry system by focusing on the accounting equation Demonstrate: Lead students to demonstrate on how to use accounting equation
Think-ink-pair-share: meaning of assets, liabilities, capital, revenue and expenses Panel Discussion: discuss types of accounts and conclude
assessment_criteria: Concept of Book- keeping is clearly explained
Accounting assumptions and principles are well explained
The double entry theory and the accounting equation are well described
The five key accounts are well described
resources: Sample of invoice/ receipt YouTube Channels Interactive Website
Accounting Forums and Communities Websites Sample of invoice/ receipt
Sample of ledger Sample of receipts and payments
Accounting Software Tutorials Interactive Learning Platforms

specific_competences.main_competence: . Demonstrate mastery of the principles of Book-keeping
specific_competences.specific_competence: Record business transactions using source documents
learning_activities: (a) Identify sources of business transactions (source documents)
(b) Record business transactions from various source documents
(c) Post recorded business transactions from books of original entry to ledger accounts and balance off the accounts
teaching_methods: Gallery walks: Guide students through gallery walk to identify source documents of business transactions Summarize and conclude the lesson

Skills lab: Demonstrate: how to record business transactions from various source documents Practice: Guide students individually to practice on how to record business transactions and present their work. Summarize and conclude the lesson

Skills lab: Demonstrate: on how to post business transactions from the books of original entry to the ledger accounts and balance off the accounts Practice: Guide students individually to practice on how to post business transactions and present their work Summarize and conclude the lesson
assessment_criteria: Various sources of business transactions are identified
Business transactions are correctly recorded
Posting is correctly done
resources: Sample of a ledger Sample of Book of Orginal Entry

specific_competences.main_competence: . Demonstrate mastery of the principles of Book-keeping
specific_competences.specific_competence: . Prepare a trial balance
learning_activities: (a) Describe the trial balance
(b) Prepare a trial balance to check the arithmetical accuracy of ledger accounts
teaching_methods: Group Discussions: discuss the meaning of trial balance and its importance Demonstrate: on how to prepare the trial balance and let students practice thereafter conclude

Group Discussion: errors that may happen in the trial balance Skills lab: Demonstrate on how to check errors in ledger accounts through trial balance and to prepare the trial balance to check the arithmetical accuracy of the ledger accounts
assessment_criteria: The Trial balance is well described
Trial balance is prepared correctly

specific_competences.main_competence: Prepare basic financial statements
specific_competences.specific_competence: . Prepare basic profit or loss statements
learning_activities: (a) Describe basic financial statements (meaning, types, purpose, content and format)
(b) Prepare a basic income statement
teaching_methods: Brainstorming: financial statements how they look like and then share the meaning, types and purpose of financial statements. Skills lab: Demonstrate by prepare different format of financial statements and show their key contents practice how to prepare formats of financial statements Guide students present their work and conclude
Demonstrate: how to prepare income statement Practice: Guide students to prepare basic income statement Presentation: Guide students to present their work for conclusion
assessment_criteria: Basic financial statements are well described
Basic income statement is well prepared

specific_competences.main_competence: Prepare basic financial statements
specific_competences.specific_competence: Prepare basic business financial position statements
learning_activities: (a) Classify assets and liabilities
(b) Prepare a basic statement of financial position
teaching_methods: Group Discussion Students in groups to discuss the classification of accounts Practice: Guide students to classify assets and liabilities of an enterprise
Demonstrate: how to prepare basic financial statement Practice: Guide students to prepare basic financial statement Presentation: Guide students to present their work for conclusion
assessment_criteria: Assets and liabilities are correctly classified
Basic statement of financial position correctly prepared

specific_competences.main_competence: Demonstrate mastery of the principles of Book- keeping
specific_competences.specific_competence: Record business transactions using source documents
learning_activities: (a) Describe cash and banking transactions (types of cash books)
(b) Record cash/ bank receipts and payments from various source documents in the Cash Book
(double column, three-column or petty cash book)
teaching_methods: Guest Speaker: Invite an accountant from nearby office to share knowledge and skills about cash and banking transactions by addressing types of cash books Summarize the lesson by linking the guest speaker experience on types of cash books and then let students reflect on the guest speaker
Skills club: discuss aspects that should be observed when you record cash/bank receipts and payments from various source documents in the cash book and lead them to present.
Business club: Design a project that will enable students practice to record cash/bank receipts and payments from various source documents. Guide students to present their works and conclude
assessment_criteria: Different types of cash books are well described
Double column, Three- column and Petty cash book are correctly prepared

specific_competences.main_competence: Demonstrate mastery of the principles of Book- keeping
specific_competences.specific_competence: . Prepare a Trial balance
learning_activities: (a) Describe errors in the Trial balance (meaning, types, sources and detection)
(b) Correct errors in the Trial balance by means of journal entries and adjust the trial balance
teaching_methods: Group discussion: Lead students to discuss meaning, types, sources and detection of trial balance Summarize and conclude the lesson

Demonstration: on how to correct errors in the trial balance by using journal entries and adjust the trial balance Practice: guide students to practice on how to correct errors in the trial balance and adjust the trial balance Presentation: Guide students to present their works and conclude
assessment_criteria: Errors in the trial balance are well described
Errors in the trial balance are well corrected

specific_competences.main_competence: Demonstrate mastery of financial assets control
specific_competences.specific_competence: . Prepare bank reconciliation statements
learning_activities: (a) Describe a Bank reconciliation statement (meaning, importance, reasons for inconsistencies, and the key terms used)
(b) Prepare adjusted cash book and bank reconciliation statement.
teaching_methods: Guest Speaker: Invite the guest speaker to talk about bank reconciliation statement Skills lab: Guide students to discuss on meaning, importance, reasons for inconsistencies and the key terms used in bank reconciliation statement Demonstrate: Demonstrate on how to prepare bank reconciliation statement Practice: Guide students to prepare bank reconciliation statement and conclude

Project: Design a project that will enable students to prepare adjusted cash book and bank reconciliation statement Feedback: Make project results feedback that will enable students to reflect on their work
assessment_criteria: Bank reconciliation statement is well described
adjusted cash book and Bank reconciliation statement are correctly prepared

specific_competences.main_competence: Demonstrate mastery of financial assets control
specific_competences.specific_competence: . Prepare a financial budget
learning_activities: (a) Describe Budgeting and budgetary control process (meaning, importance, approaches, and features of a good budget )
(b) Prepare a simple cash budget
teaching_methods: Think-ink-pair-share: Students to individually think and then share on the term budgeting and budgetary
Demonstrate: Demonstrate on how to prepare simple cash budget. Practice: Guide students to prepare simple cash budget and conclude
assessment_criteria: Budgeting and budgetary control process is well described
A simple cash budget is correctly prepared

specific_competences.main_competence: Demonstrate mastery of financial assets control
specific_competences.specific_competence: Prepare a Trial balance
learning_activities: (a) Describe control accounts
(b) Prepare Purchases and Sales Ledgers as further controls of the arithmetical accuracy of ledger accounts
teaching_methods: Group discussion: In groups students to discuss control accounts Presentation: Guide students to present what they have discussed and conclude

Demonstrate: Demonstrate on how to prepare purchases and sales ledger control account as a further check of arithmetical accuracy of accounts Practice: Guide students to prepare purchases ledger and sales ledger control account as a further check of arithmetical accuracy of ledger accounts
assessment_criteria: Control accounts are well described
Purchases ledger and sales ledger control accounts are correctly prepared
resources: Sample of Purchases and Sales Ledgers

specific_competences.main_competence: Prepare basic financial statements
specific_competences.specific_competence: . Prepare basic profit or loss statements
learning_activities: (a) Describe the necessary adjustments needed in the preparation of financial statements (depreciation, bad debts and doubtful debts
(b) Prepare a comprehensive income statement with adjustments
(c) Estimate profit or loss for the period from incomplete records
teaching_methods: Brainstorm: The need to account for depreciation Library/internet search: Ask students to use accessible resources in order to search depreciation, bad debts, doubtful debts and IAS 16 Practice: Guide students to calculate depreciation of an asset by using different methods Guide students to record depreciation, bad debts and doubtful debts in the respective accounts Group discussion: Guide students to discuss and prepare adjusted financial statements and conclude
Demostration: Demonstrate on how to prepare a comprensive income statement with adjustments Practice: Guide students to prepare a comprehensive income statement with adjustments and conclude

Demonstration: By focusing on single entry demonstrate how to estimate profit or loss for the period from incomplete records Practice: Guide students to estimate profit or loss for the period from an incomplete record, and conclude
assessment_criteria: Adjustments needed in the preparation of financial statements are correctly illustrated
Income statement including year end adjustments are correctly prepared
Profit or loss for the period from an incomplete record is clearly estimated

specific_competences.main_competence: Prepare basic financial statements
specific_competences.specific_competence: . Prepare basic business financial position statements
learning_activities: (a) Differentiate between capital and revenue expenditures and their effect on financial statements
(b) Prepare a comprehensive statement of financial position
teaching_methods: Group discussion: Guide the student to discuss capital and revenue expenditure and how they affect financial statements Practice: Guide students individually to differentiate between capital and revenue expenditure and their effect in financial statements Summarize and conclude the lesson
Demonstration: Demonstrate how to prepare statement of financial position Practice: Guide students to prepare statement of financial position and conclude
assessment_criteria: Capital and revenue expenditure are well distinguished
A statement of financial position with year end adjustment or from incomplete records is correctly prepared
resources: Sample of business financial position statements
Sample of business financial position statements

(b) Prepare the relevant accounts for Not-For Profit organizations (receipts and payments accounts, Income and expenditure statements and a statement of financial position)

learning_activities: (a) Describe the basis of accounting (cash basis and accrual basis)
(b) Adjust various recorded business transactions in the financial statements based on appropriate accounting basis (accruals and pre-payments)
teaching_methods: Group Discussion: In groups students to discuss the basis of accounting Presentation: Guide students to present in plenary and thereafter conclude

Demonstration: Demonstrate on how to adjust various balance for financial statements based on appropriate accounting basis Practice: Guide students to adjust various balance for financial statements financial statements based on appropriate accounting basis Summarise and conclude the lesson

Various business transactions recorded under accrual basis of accounting are correctly adjusted

specific_competences.main_competence: . Prepare basic financial statements
specific_competences.specific_competence: . Prepare basic profit or loss statements
learning_activities: (a) Describe various forms of business arrangements (manufacturing firms; consignment arrangement; partnership and joint venture agreement and departmental stores)

partnership firms-admission and retirement of a partner; joint venture; consignments and departmental stores)

Practice: Guide students to practice what you have demonstrated Summarise and conclude the lesson

Relevant accounts to determine the profit or loss for different forms of businesses are correctly prepared
